Thanks again for the great discovery call this morning. Quick recap of the key points I captured:

- Primary constraints: PHI handling, SOC 2 controls, and an internal SLA for response time.

Per our discussion, the best next step is a technical deep dive (60-90 minutes) with your ML and infra leads plus our solutions engineering team so we can align on architecture, performance targets, and integration plan. Would the following windows work for your team?

- Tue, Aug 18 -- 10:00-11:30 PT (90 min)

If those don't fit, feel free to pick a slot on my calendar: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/technical-deep-dive

Proposed NovaBio attendees: ML lead, Head of Infra, Security/Compliance as relevant.

I've attached the short discovery notes from today and a one-page summary of the items we'd like to cover. Please let me know preferred time and any other people we should include.

Thanks -- looking forward to it.
